method: Stored results from exact rational inequalities on serialized values; no validation epsilon in the zero-tolerance case.
limitations: The original acquisition and parsing program was not preserved.
Not every exact upstream payload can be reacquired from an immutable reference.
The rankings are internally checkable stored results, not independent proof of leaderboard position.
The rational 1e-6 contract is not asserted to be bit-for-bit equivalent to the public binary64 evaluator.
